content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist? I installed [product_name] [version_no] on my new computer and while the software runs smoothly, the icons are extremely small—no larger than a few millimeters. Since I didn’t have a DVD, I copied the files to an external drive and proceeded with installation via USB. My device is a Microsoft Surface Book 2. Has anyone encountered this issue or found a solution? Thanks in advance. Kind regards, [user_name]

Hi [user_name], Try this solution—it could help. Right-click the main executable, go to Properties, then the Compatibility tab, and check the option to disable or override display scaling on high DPI settings. For scaling, choose either Application or System.

Hello [user_name], Your suggestion worked perfectly! Thanks a lot. Without your help, I might have searched for a solution for a long time and not found it. You’ve taught me and probably others something new. Thank you again. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing a user interface issue with [product_name] [version_no] on high-DPI screens, where icons appear much too small. The software itself runs without problems, but usability is affected due to tiny icons on devices such as the Microsoft Surface Book 2 running Windows 10.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to display icons at a readable size so the interface matches current high-DPI display standards and offers a comfortable experience.
